{{Quote|Where are the patrol droids and security feeds? This outpost violates Imperial Code 877 as well!|I-M3|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Imperial Code 877''' was a regulation in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that stipulated Imperial outposts utilize security feeds and patrol droids.
